abstract: Most malignant ovarian tumors metastasize by peritoneal dissemination and have a poor prognosis. Few studies have been made to determine how free ovarian tumor cells act on the peritoneum and become lodged and proliferate therein and much still remains to be clarified concerning this issue. In the present study, we transplanted 2 X 10(6) cells of JOHYL-1 strain established from an atypical dysgerminoma into the peritoneal cavity of nude mice observed serially morphological changes in the peritoneum resulting from tumor cell dissemination both by light microscopy and SEM. The findings thus obtained may be summarized as follows: From 5 to 7 days after intraperitoneal transplantation of tumor cells, mesothelial cells of the peritoneum began to swell, with the intercellular boundaries becoming distinct. Microvilli of the mesothelial cells increased in number, forming a mesh-like structure, and in some places were found to be in direct contact with a tumor cell. From 10 days after tumor cell transplantation onwards the mesothelium showed enlarged intercellular spaces in some places, and at these sites tumor cells were seen to have adhered. On other sites mesothelial cells were being partially lost. From 11 days after being transplanted, the tumor cells started proliferating and infiltrating in the muscle layer. Concerning the site of tumor cell implantation, evidence was obtained showing that tumor cells adhered to intercellular spaces of mesothelial cells, and/or in defects formed on connective tissue by a loss of mesothelial cells. The study thus demonstrated a salient usefulness of the JOHYL-1 ascites type cell line, with a reliably great capacity for growth in vivo, as an experimental model for the study of peritoneal dissemination of tumor cells.
abstract_ja: 悪性卵巣腫瘍の多くは腹膜播種により転移し、予後は不良である。遊離した卵巣腫瘍細胞が腹膜に定着し増殖する仕組みはほとんど解明されていない。本研究では、異型ディスジャーミノーマ由来のJOHYL-1株2×10^6個をヌードマウスの腹腔内に移植し、光学顕微鏡および走査型電子顕微鏡(SEM)で腹膜の形態変化を経時的に観察した。移植の5〜7日後、中皮細胞が腫大し細胞間境界が明瞭になった。中皮細胞の微絨毛は増加して網目状構造を形成し、一部では腫瘍細胞と直接接触していた。移植10日後以降、一部では中皮細胞間隙が拡大し、その部位に腫瘍細胞が接着した。他の部位では中皮細胞が部分的に脱落していた。移植11日後から、腫瘍細胞は増殖して筋層へ浸潤し始めた。腫瘍細胞は中皮細胞間隙、または中皮細胞の脱落により生じた結合組織の欠損部に接着することが示された。本研究は、in vivoで高い増殖能を有するJOHYL-1腹水型細胞株が、腫瘍細胞の腹膜播種を研究する実験モデルとして有用であることを示した。
